mapper.sql: m.is_delete = 0 AND m.match_status = 3 AND m.data_status = 2 AND m.home_team_id IS NOT NULL AND m.away_team_id IS NOT NULL AND m.home_team_id <> m.away_team_id AND m.home_score >= 0 AND m.away_score >= 0
mapper.select: select m.id as matchId, m.match_no as matchNo, m.season_id as seasonId, m.stage_id as stageId, ifnull(m.group_id, 0) as groupId, m.home_team_id as homeTeamId, m.away_team_id as awayTeamId, m.home_score as homeScore, m.away_score as awayScore, m.winner_team_id as winnerTeamId, m.walkover_team_id as walkoverTeamId, m.match_status as matchStatus, m.data_status as dataStatus, m.scheduled_start_time as scheduledStartTime, m.actual_end_time as actualEndTime, ht.result_type as homeResultType, at.result_type as awayResultType from basket_match m left join basket_match_team ht on ht.match_id = m.id and ht.team_id = m.home_team_id and ht.is_delete = 0 left join basket_match_team at on at.match_id = m.id and at.team_id = m.away_team_id and at.is_delete = 0 where and m.season_id = #{seasonId} and m.stage_id = #{stageId} and ifnull(m.group_id, 0) = #{groupId} order by m.scheduled_start_time asc, m.id asc

select m.id as matchId, m.match_no as matchNo, m.season_id as seasonId, m.stage_id as stageId, ifnull(m.group_id, 0) as groupId, m.home_team_id as homeTeamId, m.away_team_id as awayTeamId, m.home_score as homeScore, m.away_score as awayScore, m.winner_team_id as winnerTeamId, m.walkover_team_id as walkoverTeamId, m.match_status as matchStatus, m.data_status as dataStatus, m.scheduled_start_time as scheduledStartTime, m.actual_end_time as actualEndTime, ht.result_type as homeResultType, at.result_type as awayResultType from basket_match m left join basket_match_team ht on ht.match_id = m.id and ht.team_id = m.home_team_id and ht.is_delete = 0 left join basket_match_team at on at.match_id = m.id and at.team_id = m.away_team_id and at.is_delete = 0 where m.id = #{matchId} and
select count(1) from basket_match where is_delete = 0 and season_id = #{seasonId} and match_status = 5
select count(1) from basket_match where is_delete = 0 and season_id = #{seasonId} and data_status = 3

select ts.team_id as teamId, count(distinct ts.match_id) as games, sum(case when m.winner_team_id = ts.team_id then 1 else 0 end) as wins, sum(case when m.winner_team_id is not null and m.winner_team_id <> ts.team_id then 1 else 0 end) as losses, ifnull(sum(ts.points), 0) as pointsFor, ifnull(sum(case when ts.team_id = m.home_team_id then m.away_score else m.home_score end), 0) as pointsAgainst, ifnull(sum(ts.rebounds), 0) as rebounds, ifnull(sum(ts.assists), 0) as assists, ifnull(sum(ts.steals), 0) as steals, ifnull(sum(ts.blocks), 0) as blocks, ifnull(sum(ts.turnovers), 0) as turnovers, ifnull(sum(ts.field_goals_made), 0) as fieldGoalsMade, ifnull(sum(ts.field_goals_attempted), 0) as fieldGoalsAttempted, ifnull(sum(ts.three_points_made), 0) as threePointsMade, ifnull(sum(ts.three_points_attempted), 0) as threePointsAttempted, ifnull(sum(ts.free_throws_made), 0) as freeThrowsMade, ifnull(sum(ts.free_throws_attempted), 0) as freeThrowsAttempted from basket_match_team_stat ts inner join basket_match m on m.id = ts.match_id where ts.is_delete = 0 and ts.data_status = 2 and and m.season_id = #{seasonId} and m.stage_id = #{stageId} group by ts.team_id

select ps.player_id as playerId, ps.team_id as teamId, count(distinct ps.match_id) as games, ifnull(sum(ps.started_flag), 0) as starts, ifnull(sum(ps.minutes_seconds), 0) as minutesSeconds, ifnull(sum(ps.points), 0) as points, ifnull(sum(ps.rebounds), 0) as rebounds, ifnull(sum(ps.assists), 0) as assists, ifnull(sum(ps.steals), 0) as steals, ifnull(sum(ps.blocks), 0) as blocks, ifnull(sum(ps.turnovers), 0) as turnovers, ifnull(sum(ps.fouls), 0) as fouls, ifnull(sum(ps.field_goals_made), 0) as fieldGoalsMade, ifnull(sum(ps.field_goals_attempted), 0) as fieldGoalsAttempted, ifnull(sum(ps.three_points_made), 0) as threePointsMade, ifnull(sum(ps.three_points_attempted), 0) as threePointsAttempted, ifnull(sum(ps.free_throws_made), 0) as freeThrowsMade, ifnull(sum(ps.free_throws_attempted), 0) as freeThrowsAttempted, ifnull(sum(ps.efficiency), 0) as efficiencySum, ifnull(sum(ps.double_double), 0) as doubleDoubleCount, ifnull(sum(ps.triple_double), 0) as tripleDoubleCount from basket_match_player_stat ps inner join basket_match m on m.id = ps.match_id where ps.is_delete = 0 and ps.data_status = 2 and and m.season_id = #{seasonId} and m.stage_id = #{stageId} group by ps.player_id, ps.team_id
select count(1) from basket_match_team_stat where is_delete = 0 and data_status = 2 and match_id = #{matchId}
select count(1) from basket_match_player_stat where is_delete = 0 and data_status = 2 and match_id = #{matchId}
select ifnull(sum(points), 0) from basket_match_player_stat where is_delete = 0 and data_status = 2 and match_id = #{matchId} and team_id = #{teamId}
select ifnull(sum(points), 0) from basket_match_team_stat where is_delete = 0 and data_status = 2 and match_id = #{matchId} and team_id = #{teamId}
